What to look for: compare the two "Input signature:" tables in the disassembly
(there are two -- the first, near the top, is the one with the "Used" column).
On the COLOR row, the "Mask" column is "xyzw" (the parameter is declared and not
eliminated) but the trailing "Used" column is blank -- nothing follows "float" on
that line -- even though the shader body reads every component of Color via
GetAttributeAtVertex(Color, 0) and writes it straight to SV_Target. Both the
oldest DXC on Compiler Explorer (dxc_1_6_2112) and dxc_trunk show the same blank
Used column, so this predates and survives to current main.
